verses.1: And when they arrived in Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, near the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples there.
verses.2: And he said to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you. When you enter it, you will find a door that has been locked. No one has ever entered through that door before. Unlock it and bring it with you.”
verses.3: And if anyone were to ask you, “What should you do about this?” You would say that his master has a reason for doing this. And immediately, he would send him away again.
verses.4: And they went away, and found a door that was closed in front of the gates on the outside. They opened it.
verses.5: And some of those who were there said to them, “What are you doing, breaking the vase?”
verses.6: But they said what Jesus said; and they left him there.
verses.7: And they brought the vessels before Jesus. They laid their garments on the ground before Him, and He sat down beside them.
verses.8: Many of their tents were overturned along the road; others, on the other hand, were destroyed as they were cutting down trees in the fields.
verses.9: And those who led and those who followed praised him. They said, “Praise be to him who comes in the name of the Lord.”
verses.10: Praise be to the reigning king of our father David! He was indeed one of the greatest kings ever.
verses.11: And he entered into the Holy Temple. After looking around at everything that was already ready for use, he went away to Bethany, along with the twelve others.
verses.12: And in the evening, as they left Bethany, they were pursued by those people.
verses.13: And when they saw plants from afar with leaves on them, they thought that perhaps they could find something useful in those plants. But when they got closer, they found nothing but leaves. After all, it wasn’t the right time for plants to grow.
verses.14: And he replied to her, “Do not let anyone eat any fruit from your tree until the season has passed.” And his disciples listened to him.
verses.15: And they went into the temple. When they entered the temple, they began to order the sellers and buyers to leave the temple. They also destroyed the tables used by those who sold things, as well as the chairs where the sellers sat.
verses.16: And no one was allowed to repair any of the equipment within the temple.
verses.17: And he also taught them and said to them: “It is not written that my house should be called a house of prayer for all nations. But you thought that he was a wicked magician.”
verses.18: And the high priests and the officials heard this, and they wondered how they could get rid of him. For they were afraid of him; after all, the whole crowd was shocked by his teachings.
verses.19: And when it happened, they were sent out of the city.
verses.20: And as we moved forward, we saw that the plants were withered and dead due to the lack of water.
verses.21: And remembering this, Peter said to him, “Rabbi, see that vineyard I mentioned—it has been destroyed.”
verses.22: And when Jesus spoke to them, he said, “Have faith in God.”
verses.23: I say to you that whoever says to this mountain, “Be taken down and thrown into the sea,” and believes that what he says will actually happen, he will receive it.
verses.24: Therefore, I say to you: whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you will receive it. It will indeed be given to you.
verses.25: And when you stand up in prayer, bring anything that you have to offer, so that your Father in heaven may also bless you with His gifts.
verses.27: And they again go to the Holy Temple. While they were walking around the temple, the high priests, the secretaries, and the elders came towards them.
verses.28: And I said to him, “In what authority do you do these things? Who gave you the authority to do such things?”
verses.29: But Jesus said to them, “I will ask you a question. Answer me, and then I will tell you in what power I do these things.”
verses.30: Was John’s baptism from heaven, or from human beings? Please answer me.
verses.31: And they argued among themselves, saying, “What should we say? If we say, ‘From heaven,’ why don’t you believe it?”
verses.32: But let’s say it this way: It was done by people. They were afraid of the crowd, for everyone believed that John truly was a prophet.
verses.33: And when they answered Jesus, they said, “We do not know.” Then Jesus said to them, “Nor do I tell you this in any other way either.”
